title: Four walks stop on a panel control that has scrolled out of reach
goal: Four scripted runs stop because a control they need has been pushed below the visible part of the right hand panel and cannot be clicked. Either the panel now shows less than it used to and a person hits the same wall, or the runs need to scroll first. Nobody can prove clipping, size limits or stacking still work until it is settled.
notes:
Reproduced on 2026-09-08 on unmodified main (checked by stashing an unrelated harness change and rebuilding the probe; the messages are byte-identical either way). Pre-existing, not caused by the whole-component-walk fix that landed the same day.

Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/clip-contents-walk.json
  {"error": "step 12 (press): the control \"Limits\" is not where a person could click it: it is off the window, or the dock has scrolled it far enough that the panel edge cuts across the point a press would land on. Scroll to it with a scrollPanel step first.", "status": "failed"}

Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/size-limits-walk.json — same message at step 14, control "Limits".
Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/out-of-view-mark-walk.json — same message at step 8, control "Limits".
Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/contents-for-several-walk.json — same message at step 58, control "Stack".

The reach rule is PlaytestHarness.isInReach: the whole control has to be inside the window AND inside its scrolling area. Three of the four want the same control (Limits), so a section that moved or grew is the likely cause. Answer the product question first (does a person have to scroll for Limits now, and should they) before adding scrollPanel steps.
acceptance: Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/clip-contents-walk.json finishes with status passed
Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/size-limits-walk.json finishes with status passed
The task says which it was: the panel got shorter for a person too, or the runs simply needed a scroll step

log.note: Triage 2026-09-08: ran the walks myself on a probe built from HEAD (Scripts/playtest-all.sh, 12 passed, 0 failed, 2m 25s). clip-contents-walk 10s ok, size-limits-walk 9s ok, contents-for-several-walk 24s ok, out-of-view-mark-walk 9s ok. Fixed by find-out-why-thirteen-scripted-walks-are-failing with a new reveal step that scrolls until a named control is pressable, replacing hand-tuned scroll distances.
